truth_record.title: Platform task execution forwards caller-controlled task strings directly to the OS command launcher
truth_record.notes: The platform abstraction is declared in include/platform_impl.h and is discovered as an external scan root when header_files includes *.h.

threat_assumptions: Only behavior supported by the supplied code and contract evidence may be treated as concrete.
External API semantics, attacker control, deployment concurrency, and callback behavior require explicit evidence and must not be assumed from the truth title.
Attacker controllability requires a structured source or public caller contract; a dangerous sink alone is insufficient.

safe_pair_candidate.strategy: Create a standalone vulnerable/fixed-or-near-miss pair preserving the same structured anchor and changing only the claimed safety invariant.
safe_pair_candidate.compile_contract: Both variants must compile independently under the Range C toolchain.
